scenes.title: Where Did Two Trillion Vanish?
scenes.text: How did China's stock market suddenly lose two trillion dollars? It started with a normal dip. But ten weeks of nonstop drops broke the market wide open.

scenes.title: The Borrowed Money Trap
scenes.text: The real culprit? Borrowed money. When traders buy stocks on debt, even a small drop wipes out their cash completely, forcing brokers to sell everything automatically.

scenes.title: The Everyday Retail Panic
scenes.text: In China, ninety percent of trades come from everyday people on their phones. When panic spreads, millions hit sell together, turning a small dip into an avalanche.

scenes.title: Why Bailouts Couldn't Fix It
scenes.text: Property debt and tech sell-offs made it worse. Even massive government bailouts can't stop a crash until real corporate profits grow and people believe in the economy.
